questions.question: Define a scraped surface heat exchanger. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define a scraped surface heat exchanger. [U]/[CO1]
  • A scraped surface heat exchanger (SSHE) is a type of heat exchanger designed for viscous,
  • sticky, or heat-sensitive food products. It uses rotating blades to continuously scrape the inner
  • surface of the heat exchanger, preventing fouling and ensuring uniform heat transfer.

questions.question: Why is radiation dominant in high-temperature food processes like broiling? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Why is radiation dominant in high-temperature food processes like broiling? [U]/[CO1]
  • At high temperatures, heat transfer occurs mainly through electromagnetic radiation rather
  • than conduction or convection because radiant energy can travel directly through air and
  • rapidly heat the food surface.

questions.question: What is regeneration efficiency in plate heat exchangers? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• What is regeneration efficiency in plate heat exchangers? [U]/[CO1]
  • Regeneration efficiency is the ratio of heat recovered from the outgoing (hot) product to the
  • total heat required to heat the incoming (cold) product.

questions.question: Discuss how direct contact steam injection improves heating efficiency. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss how direct contact steam injection improves heating efficiency. [A]/[CO3]
  • • Steam directly contacts the product, condensing and transferring latent heat instantly.
  • • Minimizes heat loss and provides rapid temperature rise ,Ideal for liquid foods (soups,
  • sauces, milk),Reduces fouling since no heat surface contact.However, steam
  • condensate dilutes the product slightly.
